title: Story premise ENT108: The Alien Who Bought a Reflection
summary: Idea-stage fiction premise (fantasy and science fiction). Hook: I would like one moon, to go. Takeaway/theme: A representation can travel even when its source cannot.
description: An alien visitor wants to take home a shiny moon seen in a pond, but scooping the water keeps breaking the reflected image. A local artist paints a small original moon card; the alien trades a star-shaped pebble for it and holds the card still while the real reflection ripples goodbye.
